evidence: Y(thd)3 and Ce(thd)4 (thd = 2,2,6,6-tetramethylheptane-3,5-dionate) were synthesized by procedures described earlier. Ozone was employed for oxidation and was produced from oxygen (>99.999%) in an ozone generator (Fischer ,del 502). Yttrium and cerium precursors and ozone were transported onto the substrate with nitrogen carrier gas (>99.999%, Schmidlin UHPN 3000 N2 generator).
